description: Poly Prune: removes channels from a polyphonic input and closes the gaps, by gates, by a start and count, or by both, with optional sorting by voltage

params.text: Sets whether the channels are sorted by voltage and at which point: off, or ascending or descending on the input, on the result of the gate stage, or on the finished output
Sets which channel of the gated result to start from, 1 to 16, clamped to the channels actually there
Sets how many channels to keep, -16 to 16, with 0 at noon meaning all of them. A positive count runs upwards from the start channel and a negative count downwards, wrapping round the ends

inputs.text: A high gate keeps that channel and a low gate removes it, read as Schmitt triggers going high at 2V and low at 0.2V. It is normalled to 10V, so every channel is kept while it is unpatched
Bipolar CV added to the START knob at one channel per 0.5V
Bipolar CV added to the COUNT knob at one channel per 0.5V
The polyphonic signal to be pruned

outputs.text: The channels left after the gates, the start and count, and any sorting, packed down with no gaps; one channel of 0V when nothing was kept

menu: Selected, Effective start and Effective count — three rows reporting the channel count left by the gate stage and the start and count in force, read as the menu opens and not updated after
